# DLC kits

Every DLC function checks that its expansion is active and raises `RK3003` when it is not, so a mod can call them safely and handle the error, or check `game.dlc.status()` first. The kits are Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md).

```lua
local dlc = game.dlc.status()
if dlc.Ideology then
  for _, ideo in ipairs(game.ideology.list()) do
    print(ideo.name, #ideo.memes, ideo.pawns)
  end
end

if dlc.Anomaly then
  -- Tame Anomalies tuning: look further, check more often, never auto draft
  game.anomaly.set_engagement({ range = 80, interval = 15, auto_draft = false })
end
```

Ideology covers ideoligions, memes (add and remove, with the game's own conflict checks), precepts, roles, certainty, rituals, style categories and renaming. Royalty covers titles, honor, permits, psylink level, abilities, the Empire and throne rooms. Biotech covers xenotypes, gene definitions, mechanitors and their mechs, pregnancy, growth points, hemogen and gene packs. Anomaly covers the monolith, studies, containment, platforms, the codex, creepjoiners and how controlled pawns pick fights. Odyssey covers planet layers, gravship engines (fuel, launch range, cooldown, substructure, linked components), space maps and the gravship in flight. Launching, travel and orbital sites are not exposed yet, so it is still the least complete.

The older `game.anomalies` object and `game.anomaly` recruit, capture and release functions are on the [Anomaly kit](anomaly.md) page and keep working.

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.dlc.status` |  | `RimDlcStatus` | Which expansions are active. |
| `game.dlc.active` | `dlc` | `boolean` | Whether one expansion (Royalty, Ideology, Biotech, Anomaly or Odyssey) is active. |
| `game.ideology.list` |  | `RimIdeoBrief[]` | Every ideoligion with its memes and believers. |
| `game.ideology.info` | `id` | `RimIdeoInfo` | One ideoligion with its precepts and roles. |
| `game.ideology.memes` |  | `RimMemeInfo[]` | Every meme def. |
| `game.ideology.precept_defs` | `issue?` | `RimPreceptDefInfo[]` | Every precept def, optionally one issue. |
| `game.ideology.rituals` | `id` | `RimRitualInfo[]` | The rituals of an ideoligion. |
| `game.ideology.add_precept` | `id, def` | `boolean` | Adds a precept to an ideoligion. |
| `game.ideology.remove_precept` | `id, def` | `boolean` | Removes a precept from an ideoligion. |
| `game.ideology.add_meme` | `id, def` | `boolean` | Adds a meme. Raises RK1001 when it conflicts with a meme the ideoligion has, or a second structure meme. |
| `game.ideology.remove_meme` | `id, def` | `boolean` | Removes a meme. |
| `game.ideology.style_defs` |  | `RimStyleCategory[]` | Every style category def. |
| `game.ideology.styles` | `id` | `RimIdeoStyle[]` | The style categories of an ideoligion with their priority. |
| `game.ideology.set_style` | `id, def, priority?` | `boolean` | Adds a style category or changes its priority (default 1). |
| `game.ideology.remove_style` | `id, def` | `boolean` | Removes a style category. |
| `game.ideology.rename` | `id, name, adjective?` | `boolean` | Renames an ideoligion. |
| `game.ideology.of_pawn` | `pawn` | `RimIdeoBrief?` | The pawn's ideoligion with its certainty. |
| `game.ideology.set_pawn_ideo` | `pawn, id` | `boolean` | Converts the pawn to an ideoligion. |
| `game.ideology.certainty` | `pawn` | `number` | The pawn's certainty in its ideoligion, 0 to 1. |
| `game.ideology.set_certainty` | `pawn, value` | `number` | Sets certainty. |
| `game.ideology.assign_role` | `pawn, role` | `boolean` | Gives the pawn a role of its ideoligion, such as Moral guide. |
| `game.ideology.unassign_role` | `pawn` | `boolean` | Takes the pawn's role away. |
| `game.royalty.titles` |  | `RimRoyalTitleInfo[]` | Every royal title, junior first. |
| `game.royalty.permit_defs` |  | `RimPermitInfo[]` | Every permit def. |
| `game.royalty.empire` |  | `RimEmpireInfo` | The Empire faction and how it regards the player. |
| `game.royalty.title` | `pawn, faction?` | `RimRoyalTitleInfo?` | The pawn's title with a faction, the Empire by default. |
| `game.royalty.set_title` | `pawn, def?, faction?, rewards?, letter?` | `boolean` | Grants a title, or removes it when def is nil. |
| `game.royalty.favor` | `pawn, faction?` | `integer` | Honor with a faction. |
| `game.royalty.set_favor` | `pawn, value, faction?` | `integer` | Sets honor. |
| `game.royalty.permits` | `pawn` | `RimPermitInfo[]` | Permits the pawn has. |
| `game.royalty.add_permit` | `pawn, def, faction?` | `boolean` | Grants a permit. |
| `game.royalty.psylink_level` | `pawn` | `integer` | The pawn's psylink level. |
| `game.royalty.set_psylink_level` | `pawn, level` | `integer` | Changes the psylink level, 0 to 6. The pawn needs a psylink. |
| `game.royalty.abilities` | `pawn` | `RimAbilityInfo[]` | The pawn's abilities, psycasts included. |
| `game.royalty.gain_ability` | `pawn, def` | `boolean` | Gives the pawn an ability. |
| `game.royalty.entropy` | `pawn` | `RimEntropyInfo` | Neural heat and psyfocus. |
| `game.royalty.throne_rooms` | `map` | `RimThroneRoom[]` | Rooms counted as throne rooms, with the impressiveness a title requires. |
| `game.biotech.xenotypes` |  | `RimXenotypeInfo[]` | Every xenotype def. |
| `game.biotech.gene_defs` |  | `RimGeneDefInfo[]` | Every gene def with its complexity, metabolism and archite cost. |
| `game.biotech.set_xenotype` | `pawn, def` | `boolean` | Changes the pawn's xenotype. |
| `game.biotech.mechanitor` | `pawn` | `RimMechanitorInfo?` | Bandwidth and mechs of a mechanitor, nil for other pawns. |
| `game.biotech.mechs` | `pawn` | `RimPawn[]` | The mechs a mechanitor controls. |
| `game.biotech.control_mech` | `pawn, mech` | `boolean` | Makes a mech obey the mechanitor. |
| `game.biotech.pregnancy` | `pawn` | `RimPregnancy?` | The pawn's pregnancy. |
| `game.biotech.start_pregnancy` | `pawn, father?` | `boolean` | Starts a pregnancy. |
| `game.biotech.end_pregnancy` | `pawn` | `boolean` | Ends a pregnancy. |
| `game.biotech.growth` | `pawn` | `RimGrowthInfo` | Age, life stage and growth points of a child. |
| `game.biotech.set_growth_points` | `pawn, value` | `number` | Sets growth points. |
| `game.biotech.hemogen` | `pawn` | `RimHemogen?` | A sanguophage's hemogen. |
| `game.biotech.set_hemogen` | `pawn, value` | `number` | Sets hemogen. |
| `game.biotech.genepack` | `thing` | `RimGenepack` | The genes and cost of a gene pack. |
| `game.anomaly.monolith` |  | `RimMonolith` | The monolith's level and state. |
| `game.anomaly.set_monolith_level` | `level` | `integer` | Sets the monolith level, 0 to 6. |
| `game.anomaly.codex` |  | `RimCodexEntry[]` | Entity codex entries and whether each is discovered. |
| `game.anomaly.engagement` |  | `RimEngagement` | How controlled pawns pick fights. |
| `game.anomaly.set_engagement` | `opts` | `RimEngagement` | Tunes controlled pawn engagement: range, check interval, auto draft, melee range. |
| `game.anomaly.study` | `thing` | `RimStudyInfo` | Study state of an anomaly entity or object. |
| `game.anomaly.set_study` | `thing, opts` | `number` | Enables or disables study, or sets its progress. Returns progress. |
| `game.anomaly.containment` | `thing` | `RimContainment` | Containment state of an entity. |
| `game.anomaly.platforms` | `map` | `RimPlatformInfo[]` | Holding platforms and what they hold. |
| `game.anomaly.creepjoiners` | `map` | `RimPawn[]` | Creepjoiners on the map. |
| `game.anomaly.set_pawn_engagement` | `pawn, enabled` | `boolean` | Turns auto engagement on or off for one controlled pawn. |
| `game.odyssey.layers` |  | `RimLayerInfo[]` | Planet layer defs, the surface and orbit. |
| `game.odyssey.gravship` |  | `table?` | The gravship in flight, nil when none. |
| `game.odyssey.space_maps` |  | `RimSpaceMapInfo[]` | Maps that are in orbit, with their layer and precious resource. |
| `game.odyssey.engines` | `map` | `RimEngineInfo[]` | Gravship engines on a map. |
| `game.odyssey.has_engine` | `map` | `boolean` | Whether the player has a gravship engine on the map. |
| `game.odyssey.engine_info` | `thing` | `RimEngineDetail` | Fuel, launch range, cooldown, substructure size and the components a launch still needs. |
| `game.odyssey.components` | `thing` | `RimGravComponent[]` | The facilities linked to a gravship engine and whether each is active. |
